function QR8bitByte(data) {
	this.mode = QRMode.MODE_8BIT_BYTE;
	this.data = data;
}

QR8bitByte.prototype = {

	getLength : function() {
		return this.data.length;
	},
	
	write : function(buffer) {
		for (var i = 0; i < this.data.length; i++) {
			// not JIS ...
			buffer.put(this.data.charCodeAt(i), 8);
		}
	}
};

module.exports = QR8bitByte;

},"./QRBitBuffer":function(module,require){function QRBitBuffer() {
	this.buffer = [];
	this.length = 0;
}

QRBitBuffer.prototype = {

	get : function(index) {
		var bufIndex = Math.floor(index / 8);
		return ( (this.buffer[bufIndex] >>> (7 - index % 8) ) & 1) == 1;
	},
	
	put : function(num, length) {
		for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
			this.putBit( ( (num >>> (length - i - 1) ) & 1) == 1);
		}
	},
	
	getLengthInBits : function() {
		return this.length;
	},
	
	putBit : function(bit) {
	
		var bufIndex = Math.floor(this.length / 8);
		if (this.buffer.length <= bufIndex) {
			this.buffer.push(0);
		}
	
		if (bit) {
			this.buffer[bufIndex] |= (0x80 >>> (this.length % 8) );
		}
	
		this.length++;
	}
};

module.exports = QRBitBuffer;

	glog : function(n) {
	
		if (n < 1) {
			throw new Error("glog(" + n + ")");
		}
		
		return QRMath.LOG_TABLE[n];
	},
	
	gexp : function(n) {
	
		while (n < 0) {
			n += 255;
		}
	
		while (n >= 256) {
			n -= 255;
		}
	
		return QRMath.EXP_TABLE[n];
	},
	
	EXP_TABLE : new Array(256),
	
	LOG_TABLE : new Array(256)

};
	
for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
	QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i] = 1 << i;
}
for (var i = 8; i < 256; i++) {
	QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i] = QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i - 4]
		^ QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i - 5]
		^ QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i - 6]
		^ QRMath.EXP_TABLE[i - 8];

}

},"./QRPolynomial":function(module,require){var QRMath = require('./QRMath');

function QRPolynomial(num, shift) {
	if (num.length === undefined) {
		throw new Error(num.length + "/" + shift);
	}

	var offset = 0;

	while (offset < num.length && num[offset] === 0) {
		offset++;
	}

	this.num = new Array(num.length - offset + shift);
	for (var i = 0; i < num.length - offset; i++) {
		this.num[i] = num[i + offset];
	}
}

QRPolynomial.prototype = {

	get : function(index) {
		return this.num[index];
	},
	
	getLength : function() {
		return this.num.length;
	},
	
	multiply : function(e) {
	
		var num = new Array(this.getLength() + e.getLength() - 1);
	
		for (var i = 0; i < this.getLength(); i++) {
			for (var j = 0; j < e.getLength(); j++) {
				num[i + j] ^= QRMath.gexp(QRMath.glog(this.get(i) ) + QRMath.glog(e.get(j) ) );
			}
		}
	
		return new QRPolynomial(num, 0);
	},
	
	mod : function(e) {
	
		if (this.getLength() - e.getLength() < 0) {
			return this;
		}
	
		var ratio = QRMath.glog(this.get(0) ) - QRMath.glog(e.get(0) );
	
		var num = new Array(this.getLength() );
		
		for (var i = 0; i < this.getLength(); i++) {
			num[i] = this.get(i);
		}
		
		for (var x = 0; x < e.getLength(); x++) {
			num[x] ^= QRMath.gexp(QRMath.glog(e.get(x) ) + ratio);
		}
	
		// recursive call
		return new QRPolynomial(num, 0).mod(e);
	}
};

module.exports = QRPolynomial;

                for (var r = -1; r <= 1; r++) {

	for (var x = 0; x < rsBlocks.length; x++) {
		totalDataCount += rsBlocks[x].dataCount;
	}

            ")");

		maxEcCount = Math.max(maxEcCount, ecCount);

function cartKey(account){return (trainingMode?"nini-training-cart-":"nini-cart-")+account}
function watchShopDate(onDate){
 let timer;
 function refresh(){
   clearTimeout(timer);
   const now=Date.now(),day=Qe(now);
   onDate(day);
   const midnight=Date.parse(day+"T00:00:00+07:00")+86400000;
   timer=setTimeout(refresh,Math.max(1,midnight-now));
 }
 refresh();
 window.addEventListener("pageshow",refresh);
 window.addEventListener("focus",refresh);
 document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",refresh);
 return ()=>{clearTimeout(timer);window.removeEventListener("pageshow",refresh);window.removeEventListener("focus",refresh);document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange",refresh)};
}

function recentShopOrders(orders,day){
 return orders.filter(order=>Qe(order.createdAt)===day).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.createdAt).getTime()-new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
}
function receiptProductNameEnglish(line){
 const name=String(line.name||"").trim(),english=String(line.englishName||"").trim();
 const sizeOnly=/^(?:(?:size|volume|net\s*volume)\s*[:\-]?\s*)?[\d,.]+\s*(?:ml|m[lL]|l|litres?|liters?|oz|g|kg)\.?$/i;
 if(english&&!sizeOnly.test(english))return english;
 const translations=[["ชาเขียว","Green Tea"],["ชาไทย","Thai Tea"],["ลิ้นจี่","Lychee"],["องุ่น","Grape"],["แอปเปิ้ล","Apple"],["แอปเปิล","Apple"],["สตรอว์เบอร์รี","Strawberry"],["สตรอเบอร์รี่","Strawberry"],["สตรอเบอรี่","Strawberry"],["บลูเบอร์รี่","Blueberry"],["บลูเบอร์รี","Blueberry"],["เสาวรส","Passion Fruit"],["สับปะรด","Pineapple"],["แตงโม","Watermelon"],["มะพร้าว","Coconut"],["มะม่วง","Mango"],["มะนาว","Lime"],["ลำไย","Longan"],["พีช","Peach"],["ดั้งเดิม","Original"]];
 // Mixed names such as Lychee (ลิ้นจี่) already contain the shop's English flavour.
 const latin=name.replace(/\([^)]*[\u0E00-\u0E7F][^)]*\)/g,"").trim();
 let flavour=latin&&!/[\u0E00-\u0E7F]/.test(latin)?latin:"";
 if(!flavour){const translated=translations.find(([thai])=>name===thai||name.replace(/^รส(?:ชาติ)?\s*/,"").trim()===thai);if(translated)flavour=translated[1]}
 // Keep an unrecognised name visible rather than silently dropping the flavour.
 flavour=flavour||name||"Item";
 return english&&sizeOnly.test(english)&&!flavour.toLowerCase().includes(english.toLowerCase())?flavour+" · "+english:flavour;
}

", "เลขผู้เสียภาษี ": "Tax ID ", "ใบเสร็จรับเงิน": "Receipt", "บิลยกเลิก": "Cancelled receipt", "คิว ": "Queue ", " (ฟรี)": " (free)", "รวมสินค้า": "Subtotal", "ส่วนลด": "Discount", "ยอดชำระ": "Total", "เงินทอน": "Change", "ค่าธรรมเนียม GP": "GP fee", "หมายเหตุ: ": "Note: ", "ยกเลิก: ": "Cancelled: ", "ใบเสร็จทั่วไป · ไม่ใช่ใบกำกับภาษี": "Receipt · Not a tax invoice", "ยกเลิกบิล": "Cancel bill", "ปิด": "Close", "พิมพ์ใบเสร็จ": "Print receipt", "หน้าร้าน": "In store", "กลับบ้าน": "Takeaway", "เดลิเวอรี่": "Delivery", "โอนเงิน": "Bank transfer", "เงินสด": "Cash", "บัตร / เครื่องรับบัตร": "Card", "เจ้าของร้าน": "Shop owner", "ปกติ": "Regular", "ใหญ่": "Large", "หวานน้อย": "Less sweet", "หวานมาก": "Extra sweet", "หวานปกติ": "Regular sweetness", "ไม่หวาน": "Unsweetened", "ขอบคุณที่แวะมาเติมความสุขด้วยกัน ♡": "Thank you for visiting ♡", "ค่าส่ง": "Delivery fee"};

function summarizeFreeProducts(orders,startDate,endDate){
 const rows=new Map();let bottles=0,cost=0,bills=0,missing=0;
 for(const order of orders||[]){
  if(order.status!=="paid")continue;
  const date=new Date(order.createdAt);
  if(!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))continue;
  const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA",{timeZone:"Asia/Bangkok",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"}).formatToParts(date);
  const part=type=>parts.find(p=>p.type===type).value;
  const day=part("year")+"-"+part("month")+"-"+part("day");
  if(day<startDate||day>endDate)continue;
  let hasFree=false;
  for(const line of order.lines||[]){
   const qty=Number(line.qty);
   if(line.free!==true||!Number.isFinite(qty)||qty<=0)continue;
   hasFree=true;
   const name=String(line.name||line.englishName||"ไม่ระบุชื่อสินค้า"),size=String(line.size||"");
   const key=JSON.stringify([line.productId||"",name,size]);
   if(!rows.has(key))rows.set(key,{key,name,size,qty:0,cost:0,missing:0});
   const row=rows.get(key);row.qty+=qty;bottles+=qty;
   const known=line.cost!==null&&line.cost!==undefined&&line.cost!==""&&Number.isFinite(Number(line.cost))&&Number(line.cost)>=0;
   if(known){row.cost+=Number(line.cost);cost+=Number(line.cost);}
   else{row.missing+=qty;missing+=qty;}
  }
  if(hasFree)bills++;
 }
 return {rows:[...rows.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.qty-a.qty||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"th")),bottles,cost,bills,missing};
}

    c.jsxs("div",{children:[c.jsx("span",{children:summary.missing?"ต้นทุนที่มีข้อมูล":"ต้นทุนสินค้าแถมรวม"}),c.jsx("strong",{children:ne(summary.cost)}),c.jsx("small",{children:"รวมต้นทุนตัวเลือกเพิ่มเติม"})]})

  const parts=String(date||"").split("-").map(Number);

  return new Date(Date.UTC(parts[0],parts[1]-1,parts[2]+days,12)).toISOString().slice(0,10);

<style>
/* TID WHAN POS · modern sales report */
.main:has(.sales-report-module){background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff5fb 0%,#fffaf6 58%,#fff8ef 100%)}
.main:has(.sales-report-module) .page-heading .eyebrow{color:#f0278b;letter-spacing:2.2px;font-weight:800}
.main:has(.sales-report-module) .page-heading .heading-dot{color:#f0278b}
.main:has(.sales-report-module) .heading-actions .btn{background:#fff;border:1px solid #f1d7e8;color:#29252b;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #e7b9d433}
.sales-filterbar{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px!important;align-items:center!important;margin:0 0 20px!important;padding:18px!important;border:1px solid #f4e4ef!important;border-radius:24px!important;box-shadow:0 8px 26px #dba9c51c!important}
.sales-filterbar .filter-title{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0!important;color:#766b75;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.sales-filterbar select{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%!important;min-height:48px;padding:10px 14px!important;border:1px solid #e8dbea!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#fff;font-size:15px!important}
.sales-filterbar input[aria-label="ตั้งแต่วันที่"]{grid-column:1;min-width:0;width:100%!important;min-height:48px;padding:10px 12px!important;border:1px solid #e8dbea!important;border-radius:14px!important;font-size:14px!important}
.sales-filterbar>span{grid-column:2;text-align:center;font-size:13px!important;color:#7b7180}
.sales-filterbar input[aria-label="ถึงวันที่"]{grid-column:3;min-width:0;width:100%!important;min-height:48px;padding:10px 12px!important;border:1px solid #e8dbea!important;border-radius:14px!important;font-size:14px!important}
.sales-filterbar .btn{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;margin:0!important;min-height:50px;padding:12px 18px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:15px!important;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#ff4eaa,#e60078)!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 8px 18px #ef168044}
.sales-filterbar .btn:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait}
.sales-report-module{display:grid;gap:18px;min-width:0;margin:0 0 24px}
.sales-report-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.sales-kpi{min-width:0;min-height:144px;padding:17px 18px 15px;border:1px solid #ffffffd9;border-radius:23px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #cbaac51c;overflow:hidden}
.sales-kpi-pink{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff0f8 0%,#ffd9ee 100%);color:#211b25}
.sales-kpi-purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7f0ff 0%,#e7d6ff 100%);color:#211b25}
.sales-kpi-mint{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#effff4 0%,#d4f8df 100%);color:#211b25}
.sales-kpi-cream{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffbed 0%,#ffedc7 100%);color:#211b25}
.sales-kpi-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;color:#4f4a50;font-size:clamp(11px,2.6vw,14px);font-weight:750;line-height:1.35}
.sales-kpi-pink .sales-kpi-heading svg{color:#f01b88}
.sales-kpi-purple .sales-kpi-heading svg{color:#9638e8}
.sales-kpi-mint .sales-kpi-heading svg{color:#20b85b}
.sales-kpi-cream .sales-kpi-heading svg{color:#e6a300}
.sales-kpi>strong{display:block;margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:clamp(20px,4.4vw,29px);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.8px;line-height:1.18;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sales-kpi>small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.sales-kpi-change.up{color:#16a34a}
.sales-kpi-change.down{color:#dc3545}
.sales-kpi-change span{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:#6e6870}
.sales-kpi>p{margin:8px 0 0;color:#716a70;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
.sales-bills-panel{margin:0!important;padding:18px!important;border:1px solid #f1e7ef!important;border-radius:25px!important;box-shadow:0 9px 26px #cbaac51c!important}
.sales-bills-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.sales-bills-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.sales-bills-title h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:850;margin:0;color:#26232a}
.sales-bills-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff0f8;color:#ed1687}
.sales-bills-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:9px;color:#77717a;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-view-all{border:0;background:#fff0f8;color:#df147b;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.sales-bill-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
.sales-bill-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) 14px;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:12px 11px;border:1px solid #eee8ef;border-radius:17px;background:#fff;color:#25232a;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
.sales-bill-row:active{transform:scale(.995)}
.sales-bill-row.latest{border-color:#ff70b9;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff8fc,#fff)}
.sales-bill-cart{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:13px;background:#fff0f8;color:#ec1988}
.sales-bill-content{display:grid;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.sales-bill-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.sales-bill-top>b{font-size:14px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-bill-top time{font-size:11px;color:#77717a;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-bill-top>strong{margin-left:auto;font-size:15px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-bill-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}
.sales-channel-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:9px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-channel-badge.store{background:#ffe4f2;color:#c81470}
.sales-channel-badge.online{background:#efe2ff;color:#7633bd}
.sales-channel-badge.page{background:#e9eaff;color:#5558a5}
.sales-channel-badge.delivery{background:#e2f8e8;color:#168347}
.sales-bill-customer{font-size:11px;color:#625d65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sales-payment-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}
.sales-payment-status.paid{color:#16a34a}
.sales-payment-status.cancelled{color:#dc3545}
.sales-payment-status.pending{color:#d97706}
.sales-bill-arrow{font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:#77717a;text-align:center}
.sales-bills-empty{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:8px;padding:30px 12px;color:#8b8490;text-align:center}
.sales-bills-empty svg{color:#d5c7d2}
.sales-bills-empty strong{color:#514a53;font-size:14px}
.sales-bills-empty span{font-size:12px}
.sales-report-note{margin:0;color:#807783;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}
.sales-bill-skeletons{display:grid;gap:9px}
.sales-bill-skeleton{height:66px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f7f1f6,#fff,#f7f1f6);background-size:200% 100%;animation:salesPulse 1.2s linear infinite}
@keyframes salesPulse{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.sales-detail-backdrop{position:fixed;z-index:1000;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;background:#17121d88;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
.sales-detail-dialog{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(100%,560px);max-height:min(90vh,850px);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 22px 70px #120b1b40}
.sales-detail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0e8ef}
.sales-detail-head small{color:#e91e87;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:2px}
.sales-detail-head h2{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:20px}
.sales-detail-head button{width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#f7f2f6;font-size:25px;color:#554b55}
.sales-detail-body{overflow:auto;padding:18px 20px}
.sales-detail-number{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding-bottom:13px;border-bottom:1px dashed #e8dfe7}
.sales-detail-number>b{font-size:18px}
.sales-detail-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin:14px 0 20px;color:#68616b;font-size:12px}
.sales-detail-body h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px}
.sales-detail-lines{display:grid;gap:8px}
.sales-detail-lines>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:start;gap:4px 12px;font-size:12px}.sales-detail-lines>div small{grid-column:1/-1;color:#9b570e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.sales-detail-totals>div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:12px}
.sales-detail-lines>div span{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sales-detail-totals{display:grid;gap:9px;margin-top:17px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed #e8dfe7}
.sales-detail-grand{padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #eee5ed;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:850}
.sales-detail-note,.sales-detail-cancel{margin:12px 0 0;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f8f5f8;color:#655d66;font-size:12px}
.sales-detail-cancel{background:#fff0f0;color:#b42318}
.sales-detail-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid #f0e8ef}
.sales-detail-actions .btn{border-radius:12px}
.sales-detail-actions .btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(105deg,#ff4eaa,#e60078);border:0;color:#fff}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .sales-filterbar{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)!important;padding:14px!important;gap:10px!important}
 .sales-filterbar .filter-title,.sales-filterbar select,.sales-filterbar .btn{grid-column:1/-1}
 .sales-filterbar>span{display:none}
 .sales-filterbar input[aria-label="ตั้งแต่วันที่"]{grid-column:1}
 .sales-filterbar input[aria-label="ถึงวันที่"]{grid-column:2}
 .sales-report-kpis{gap:10px}
 .sales-kpi{min-height:135px;padding:14px 13px;border-radius:19px}
 .sales-kpi>strong{font-size:clamp(18px,5vw,24px)}
 .sales-kpi-heading{font-size:11px}
 .sales-bills-panel{padding:13px!important;border-radius:21px!important}
 .sales-bills-title h2{font-size:18px}
 .sales-bills-actions{font-size:10px;gap:6px}
 .sales-bill-row{grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) 10px;gap:7px;padding:10px 8px;border-radius:14px}
 .sales-bill-cart{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px}
 .sales-bill-top{gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
 .sales-bill-top>b{font-size:12px}
 .sales-bill-top time{font-size:10px}
 .sales-bill-top>strong{font-size:13px}
 .sales-bill-bottom{gap:5px}
 .sales-channel-badge{font-size:9px;padding:4px 7px}
 .sales-bill-customer,.sales-payment-status{font-size:10px}
 .sales-detail-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .sales-detail-actions{padding:12px}
 .sales-detail-actions .btn{font-size:12px;padding:9px 11px}
}
@media(min-width:900px){
 .sales-report-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .sales-kpi{min-height:154px;padding:20px}
}
</style>

<style id="tidwhan-product-editor-actions">
.np-product-status-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:14px 2px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e1de}
.np-product-status-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;color:#282522}
.np-product-status-copy strong{font-size:17px;font-weight:650}
.np-product-status-copy small{font-size:13px;color:#77716b;line-height:1.45}
.np-status-switch{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;width:68px;height:38px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:99px;background:#bdbdbd;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease}
.np-status-switch.is-on{background:#f58200}
.np-status-switch:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.np-status-switch .np-status-knob{position:absolute;top:5px;left:5px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0002;transition:transform .18s ease}
.np-status-switch.is-on .np-status-knob{transform:translateX(30px)}
.np-product-actions{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:4px}
.np-product-actions .np-save{height:58px;border-radius:9px;font-size:18px}
.np-delete{width:100%;min-height:58px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#24272c;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.np-delete:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.np-delete:active{transform:scale(.995)}
</style>

<style id="tidwhan-receipt-language-position">
/* Receipt language selector: right-aligned, clearly separated from receipt content */
.receipt-language{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  width:100%;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:row;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  align-items:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:8px;
  padding:10px 24px;
  margin:0;
  background:#fff;
  border-top:1px solid #f0eee9;
  border-bottom:1px solid #eeece7;
}
.receipt-language button{
  appearance:none;
  -webkit-appearance:none;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  min-width:76px;
  min-height:38px;
  padding:8px 15px;
  border:1px solid #e5e1d9;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#f8f6f2;
  color:#62685b;
  font-family:inherit;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:600;
  line-height:1.2;
  white-space:nowrap;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;
}
.receipt-language button[aria-pressed="true"]{
  color:#fff;
  background:#f58200;
  border-color:#f58200;
  box-shadow:0 2px 7px #f582002b;
}
.receipt-language button:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid #f8c77d;
  outline-offset:2px;
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .receipt-language{
    padding:9px 14px;
    gap:7px;
  }
  .receipt-language button{
    min-width:70px;
    min-height:36px;
    padding:7px 13px;
    font-size:12px;
  }
}
</style>

</style><style id="tw-responsive-global">/* Global intrinsic sizing. Scroll belongs to tables and rails, not the document. */
@media screen{
html{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;min-width:0}
#root,.app,.workspace,.main,.reference-main{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.app,.workspace{width:100%}
.main>*,.pos-layout>*,.dashboard-grid>*,.settings-layout>*,.form-grid>*,.entity-grid>*,.filterbar>*,.list-toolbar>*,.sales-report-module>*{min-width:0}
.form-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.catalog,.cart-panel,.panel,.entity-card,.stock-room,.np-editor,.np-product-page,.sales-report-module,.tw-product-names{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
img,video,canvas{max-width:100%}
.category-tabs,.bill-scroll,.table-wrap,.tw-scroll,.dash-chart{min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;touch-action:pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom}
.catalog .category-tabs{margin-left:0;margin-right:0}
.tw-recent .bill-scroll{touch-action:pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom}
.searchbox input,.catalog-tools .searchbox,.list-toolbar .searchbox{min-width:0}
.catalog-tools>.btn{flex-shrink:0}
.product-info,.cart-line-detail,.stock-name,.sales-bill-content{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.dialog,.dialog-body,.dialog-head,.dialog-actions{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.dialog-head>div{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.dialog-head>.icon-btn{flex-shrink:0}
.dialog-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}.receipt{width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:900px){
.workspace{margin-left:0}
.sidebar{width:min(280px,calc(100% - 44px));max-width:100%;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);overflow-y:auto}
.topbar{padding-left:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-right));padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);height:auto;min-height:calc(65px + env(safe-area-inset-top))}
.main{padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.reference-main.pos-main{padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right);padding-bottom:calc(100px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
/* 16px controls prevent focus magnification on mobile Safari without disabling user zoom. */
.app input,.app select,.app textarea,.overlay input,.overlay select,.overlay textarea,.sales-filterbar input[aria-label]{font-size:16px!important;max-width:100%;min-width:0}
input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio]{flex-shrink:0}
.overlay{padding:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}
.dialog{max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px - env(safe-area-inset-top) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.choosing .dialog,.paying .dialog,.dialog.np-dialog{max-height:calc(100dvh - env(safe-area-inset-top));padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right)}
.dialog-actions{padding-bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.reference-main .cart-panel.cart-visible{width:100%;max-width:100%;height:100dvh;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);padding-right:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right));padding-left:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
.mobile-cart-btn{left:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-left));right:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:auto;max-width:none;min-width:0;border-radius:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:16px}
.mobile-cart-btn b{margin-left:auto;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.page-heading{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.heading-actions{max-width:100%;flex-wrap:wrap}
.list-toolbar{flex-wrap:wrap}.list-toolbar .searchbox{flex:1 1 180px;max-width:100%}
.filterbar input,.filterbar select{max-width:100%}
.np-product-page .np-editor{padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
.reference-topbar{position:relative;gap:8px;min-height:calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top))}
.reference-topbar .header-shop-logo{flex-shrink:0;width:48px;height:48px}
.reference-tools{gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}.reference-tools .icon-btn{width:36px;padding:6px}.reference-topbar .shop-status{min-width:46px}
.reference-main .product-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;padding:0 12px}
.reference-main .product-card{min-width:0}.reference-main .product-card .art-bg{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1}
.reference-main .product-card img.catalog-photo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.reference-main .product-info{padding:12px 9px}.reference-main .product-info>b{font-size:16px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.reference-price{padding:10px;font-size:20px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.catalog .catalog-tools{width:100%;gap:6px;padding:8px}.catalog-tools .searchbox{flex:1 1 0;padding:0 8px;gap:6px}.catalog-tools>.btn{padding:9px 8px;font-size:14px}
.catalog-tools .searchbox input{width:100%}
.form-grid,.settings-layout,.settings-layout>div:nth-child(2){grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.dialog-body{padding:16px 12px}.dialog-head{padding:16px 12px}.dialog-actions{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px;gap:8px}.dialog-actions .btn{white-space:normal;min-width:0}
.receipt-wrap{padding:14px 8px}.receipt-language{flex-wrap:wrap}
.stock-filter{flex-wrap:wrap}.stock-filter input,.stock-filter select{flex:1 1 150px;width:100%}
.stock-list article{grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto}.stock-list article button{max-width:100%;white-space:normal}
.sales-bill-top{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.sales-bill-top>*{max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sales-bills-header{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.sales-kpi strong{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tw-name-rank{position:static;align-self:flex-start;font-size:11px;max-width:100%;white-space:normal}.tw-name-field{padding-top:8px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){
.reference-main .product-grid{gap:8px;padding:0 8px}.catalog .category-tabs button{padding:12px 14px}
.dialog-actions .btn{flex:1 1 auto}.paying .np-transfer .payment-methods{gap:5px}
}
}
</style></body></html>
